title: Semgrep and private-storage hotfix
summary: Hardens supply-chain checks in CI, keeps ticket and case attachments off the public disk, and fixes the ticket owner search so staff always see a full list of matches.
changes: Ticket and case attachments are stored on a private disk and can only be downloaded through the authorised route. A new command moves existing files, with a dry-run first.
GitHub Actions that set up PHP are pinned to full commit SHAs, Dependabot keeps those pins current, and CI installs npm 11.10+ so the seven-day package release age setting applies.
Pull requests and pushes to main run an in-repo Semgrep scan, with triage guidance in the security policy.
Ticket owner search excludes the current owner before applying the ten-result limit, so staff always see up to ten other matches.
version_rationale: Patch: privacy and supply-chain hardening plus a small owner-search bug fix, with no new product capability.
validation: Feature tests for private attachment storage, authorised downloads, the move command, and the owner picker including a matching-owner regression.
known_limitations: Existing attachments on the public disk stay there until an administrator runs attachments:move-to-private on Cloudron after deploy.
Closing remediated findings in the Semgrep organisation UI remains a manual ops step.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. New uploads would again use the public disk default from that release; run attachments:move-to-private --reverse if files were already moved.
provenance: Milestone v0.44.x Hotfix: Semgrep security findings (#60), epic #563, ship issue #677, pull request #678.
